questions.question: If 4 men and 5 women can finish a work in 30 days and 6 men and 7 women can finish the same work in 24 days, how many days will it take for one woman alone to finish the two-third of the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

4 men and 5 women can finish the work in 30 days 

6 men and 7 women can finish the same work in 24 days

**Concept Used:**

Total number of days × Total number of workers = Total work done

**Calculation:**

As per the question,

(4M + 5W) × 30 = (6M + 7W) × 24

⇒ (4M + 5W) × 5 = (6M + 7W) × 4

⇒ 20M + 25W = 24M + 28W

⇒ 20M - 24M = 28W - 25W

⇒ 4M + 3W = 0 -----(1)

According the question 4 men and 5 women can finish the work in 30 days 

⇒ 4M + 5W = 30 -----(2)

Equation(2) - Equation(1)

(4M + 5W) - (4M + 3W) = 30 - 0

⇒ 2W = 30

Thus, 2 women can complete the work in 30 days.

⇒ 1 woman can complete the work in (30 × 2) = 60 days

⇒ Time required to complete (2/3)rd work = 60 × (2/3) = 40 days

**∴ One woman alone can complete two-third of the work in 40 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** 

In some cases, it is possible for the efficiency of workers to be negative. For example, imagine that one person can build a wall in 3 days, and another person can demolish the same wall in 8 days.

The efficiency of the first person will be positive because they are building the wall, while the efficiency of the second person will be negative because they are demolishing the wall.

questions.question: Nine solid metallic spheres of radius 2.5 cm each are melted and recast into a solid cylinder of height 7.5 cm. The curved surface area (in cm²) of the cylinder is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Nine solid metallic spheres of radius 2.5 cm each are melted and recast into a solid cylinder of height 7.5 cm

**Formula used:**

The volume of the sphere = 4/3 πr³

The volume of the cylinder = πr²h ( r = radius, h = height)

The curved surface area of the cylinder = 2πrh.

**Concept used:**

If one shape is melted and recast to another shape total volume will be the same.

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the cylinder is r cm

As per the question:

9 × (4)/(3) × π × 2.5³ = π × r² × 7.5 

⇒ r² = 4 ×​ 2.5²

⇒ ​r = √ (4 ×​ 2.5²)

⇒ r = 2 × 2.5

​⇒ ​r = 5

So, the curved surface area will be 2 × π × 5 × 7.5

⇒ 75π cm²

**The curved surface area of the cylinder is 75π cm2**

questions.question: Gita bought 80 oranges at the rate of ₹9.50 per orange. She sold 25% of these at ₹12 each and one-third of the remaining at ₹10 each. At what price per orange should she sell the remaining oranges to get an overall profit of 25%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Gita bought 80 oranges at the rate of ₹9.50 per orange.

She sold 25% of these at Rs12 each and one-third of the remaining at Rs10 each.

She has to make an overall profit of 25%

**Concept used:**

Profit is calculated on the cost price

**Formula used:**

Selling price = cost price + profit

Profit percentage = (Net profit / cost price) × 100

**Calculation:**

The total cost price of 80 oranges is 80 × 9.5 = Rs 760

25 % of 80 = 80 × 25 /100 

⇒ 20

The selling price of 20 oranges is (20 × 12) = Rs 240 

Remaining oranges is 80 - 20 = 60

1/3 of the 60 = 60 × 1 /3

⇒ 20

So she sold the next 20 oranges at 20 × 10 = Rs 200

To make a 25% Profit overall selling price is 760 × 125 / 100 = Rs 950

She has to make a profit of 950 - (240 +200) = Rs 510 by selling the remaining (80 - 40) 

⇒ 40 oranges

So the selling price will be 510 / 40 = Rs 12.75

**She** **has to sell for Rs 12.75 to make an overall profit of 25%**

questions.question: The sum of the ages of A, B and C is 66 years. The ratio of the age of A to the combined ages of B and C is 5 : 6. The ratio of the age of B to the combined ages of A and C is 4 : 7. What is the age (in years) of C?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the ages of A, B, and C is 66 years.

The ratio of the age of A to the combined ages of B and C is 5 : 6.

The ratio of the age of B to the combined ages of A and C is 4 : 7

**Calculation:**

Let the age of A is 5x, so the age of B + C = 6x

As per the question, 

A + B + C = 66

⇒ 5x + 6x = 66

⇒ 11x = 66

⇒ x = 6

So the age of A = 6 × 5 

⇒ 30 years

Age of B + C =(A + B + C) - (A)

⇒ 66 - 30

⇒ 36 years

In 2nd case,

Let the age of B is 4x, so the age of A + C = 7x

As per the question, 

A + B + C = 66

⇒ 4x + 7x = 66

⇒ 11x = 66

⇒ x = 6

So the age of B = 4 × 6 

⇒ 24 years

As per the question,

B + C = 36 years and age of B = 24 years

So age of C = 36 - 24

⇒ 12 years 

**∴The age of C is 12 years**

A and B can complete a piece of work in 12 days and 20 days, respectively.

They work together for 6 days

The remaining work is completed by C in 12 days

**Concept used:**

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

**Calculation:**

The efficiency of A = 60 /12

⇒ 5 units

The efficiency of B = 60 / 20

⇒ 3 units

So A + B together do in one day 5 + 3 = 8 units

So they do in 6 days 8 × 6 = 48 units

remaining 60 - 48 = 12 units done by C in 12 days 

So the efficiency of C = 1 unit

The combined efficiency of B + C = 3 + 1

⇒ 4 units 

 { {2} over 3} of the same work = (2/3) × 60

⇒ 40 units 

So B + C takes 40 / 4 = 10 days.

**In 10 days will B and C together complete 2/3 ****of the same work.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper marked an item at ₹4,000. He earns a profit of 20% after selling it with a 10% discount on the marked price. If he sells it at a price of ₹100 less than the marked price, then what is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper marked an item at Rs 4,000.

He earns a profit of 20% after selling it with a 10% discount on the marked price.

He sells it at a price of Rs100 less than the marked price.

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (Sp) = Cp + ((Profit)/(100)) × Cp

Market Price (Mp) - Discount = Sp

Cp = ((100)/(100space+space profitspace Percent)) × Sp

**Calculation:**

The Sp of the article = 4000 × 90 /100

⇒ Rs 3600

He earns a profit of 20 % 

So the Cp of the article = 3600 × 100 /120

⇒ Rs 3000

If he sells it at a price of ₹100 less than the marked price, then sp will be (4000 - 100) = 3900

Profit will be 3900 - 3000 = 900

So the profit percentage will be (900 / 3000) × 100 = 30%

**∴ His profit percentage will be 30**

questions.question: Find the largest number which can exactly divide 228, 282 and 288.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Find the largest number which can exactly divide 228, 282 and 288

**Concept used;**

To find the largest number which can exactly divide 228, 282 and 288, 

We have to find the HCF of 228, 282 and 288

**Calculation:**

228 = 2 × 3 × 38

282 = 2 × 3 × 47

288 = 2 × 3 × 48

HCF of 228, 282 and 288 = 2 × 3 

⇒ 6 

**The largest number which can exactly divide 228, 282 and 288 is 6**

questions.question: The speed of a train was increasing by 3 km/h after every one hour for up to 10 hours and then, it was increasing by 5 km/h. If the distance traveled in the first one hour was 40 km. what was the total distance covered by the train in 20 hours?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The speed of a train was increasing by 3 km/h after every one hour for up to 10 hours.

After 10 hrs it was increasing by 5 km/h.

The distance traveled in the first one hour was 40 km.

**Concept used:**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

For first 1 hour speed is 40 km/h.

The speed of a train was increasing by 3 km/h after every one hour .

So for the next nine hours speed will be 43,46,49,52,55,58,61,64,and 67

Total distance covered in 1st 10 hours = 43 + 46 + 49 + 52 + 55 + 58 + 61 + 64 + 67 = 535 km

So for the next 10 hours speed will be 72 ,77,82,87, 92,97,102,107,112,117

The total distance covered in next 10 hrs will be 72 + 77 + 82 + 87 + 92 + 97 + 102 + 107 + 112 + 117 = 945 km

So total distance covered in 20 hrs will be 945 + 535 = 1480 km

**The total distance covered by the train in 20 hours is 1480 km**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Given:

The speed of a train was increasing by 3 km/h after every hour for up to 10 hours.

After 10 hrs it was increasing by 5 km/h.

The distance traveled in the first hour was 40 km.

**Concept used:**

In an A.P series if the first term = a and the last term = l 

The total number of terms = n,

Then, the sum of the series will be n / 2 (a + l)

**Calculation:**

The distance traveled in the first one hour was 40 km.

We can find that the series is in A.P

First term (a) = 40 and 10th term = 67

Number of terms = 10

So, sum of the series = 10 / 2 (40 + 67)

⇒ 5 × 107

⇒ 535

Again for 2nd case, it is also an A.P series 

First term (a) = 72 and 10th term = 117

Number of terms = 10

So, sum of the series = 10 / 2 (72 + 117)

⇒ 5 × 189

⇒ 945

So total distance covered in 20 hrs will be 945 + 535 = 1480 km

The total distance covered by the train in 20 hours is 1480 km

questions.question: k is the smallest number of 5-digits, which when divided by 18, 24, 30, 40 and 42, leaves a remainder 7 in each case. The sum of the digits of k is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

k is the smallest number of 5-digits when divided by 18, 24, 30, 40, and 42, leaves a remainder of 7 in each case.

**Concept used:**

The smallest number of 5-digits is 10000.

**Calculation:**

we have to divide the number by 18, 24, 30, 40, and 42

So the number should be divided by the LCM of 18, 24, 30, 40, and 42

LCM of 18, 24, 30, 40, and 42 = 5040

Now if we divide 10000 by 5040 the remainder will be 4960

So the smallest number of 5 digits which is divided by 18, 24, 30, 40, and 42 will be 

10000 + (5040 - 4960) = 10080

So the smallest number of 5 digits which when divided by 18, 24, 30, 40, and 42 leaves 7 as a reminder will be 

10080 + 7 = 10087

The sum of the digits of 10087 will be 1 + 0 + 0 + 8 + 7 = 16

**The sum of the digits of k is 16**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**If we subtract 5040 - 4960 = 80 from 10000, the number will be 9920 which is 4 digits. Here the number has to be 5 digits.

questions.question: The average of six consecutive even numbers, taken in increasing order, is 107. What is the average of the last three numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of six consecutive even numbers, taken in increasing order, is 107

**Concept used:**

In a series of even numbers, the mean or average is the average of the middle two terms.

**Calculation:**

 the series of 6 even numbers is = 2n , 2n + 2 , 2n + 4 , 2n + 6 , 2n + 8 and 2n + 10

Again, as per the question 

((2nspace +space 4)space+space (2nspace +space 6))/(2) = 107

⇒ 2n + 4 + 2n + 6 = 107 × 2

⇒ 4n +10 = 214

⇒ 4n = 214 - 10

⇒ 4n = 204

⇒ n = 204 / 4

⇒ n = 51

Average of last three number = (6n + 24) / 3 

⇒ 2n + 8 

Average of last three number = 2 × 51 + 8 

⇒ 110

**Average of the last three numbers = 110**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Here average is given as 107.

So, The middle two terms are 107 - 1 = 106 and

107 + 1 = 108

Then the series of 6 even numbers is = 102, 104,106,108, 110, 112

The last three numbers are 108,110, 112

Average of the last three numbers = 110

Average of the last three numbers = 110

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 2n is always an even number for all values of n.
